title: RFP 521197 - Environmental Investigations and Abatement Monitoring for Asbestos, Lead, Mold, and Soil Contaminant
agency_path: City of New York > Housing Authority
submit_to: 90 church street 6th floor new york NY 10007
description_text:
NYCHA intends to enter up to four (4) agreements (the Agreement) with the selected Proposer(s) (the Selected Proposer(s) or the Consultant(s)) to provide the Services. Each Agreement will be an Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Agreement.

If a Proposer has separately been awarded an agreement by NYCHA for Services (similar to the Services or otherwise), such award shall not, in of itself, disqualify the Proposer from being awarded an Agreement pursuant to this RFP. Such award shall, however, be a factor in the evaluation criteria described in Section V of this RFP with respect to the Proposers staffing capacity and ability to perform the Services if the Proposer is awarded an Agreement.

Proposers may be awarded one of the following two (2) types of Agreements based on the qualifications submitted in their respective Proposals.

        a.    Type A Environmental Agreement (4H):

Being selected for Type A Environmental Agreement will qualify the Consultant to perform Services for all four (4) environmental hazards: asbestos, lead, mold, and soil contaminants (including soil-related contaminants such as groundwater and vapor).

           b.    Type B: Environmental Agreement (3H):

Being selected for the Type B Environmental Agreement will qualify the Consultant to perform Services for three (3) environmental hazards: asbestos, lead, and mold, but excludes soil contaminants and soil-related contaminants (including those found in soil, groundwater and vapor).

The Term of this Contract is five (5) years with no option to renew.

A non-mandatory Proposers conference (Proposers Conference) will be hosted online via Microsoft Teams on December 03, 2026, at 10:00 A.M.  Although attendance is not mandatory at the Proposers Conference, it is strongly recommended that all interested Proposers attend and that Proposers thoroughly review bid documents in advance of the meeting.
